name: Multi-Purpose Woven Plastic Storage Basket with Handles Organizer Bin for Office, Pantry, and Home
description:
Keep your essentials neatly organized with the Multi-Purpose Storage Basket with Handles. Made from high-quality, BPA-free, shatter-resistant plastic, this durable basket is designed to last. Its ventilated woven body reduces dust and odors, while the double-handled design makes it easy to carry anywhere. Compact and stackable, it saves space while keeping your items tidy and accessible, making it perfect for kitchens, offices, bathrooms, or classrooms.
Key Features:
 Dimensions: 23cm (L) × 16.5cm (W) × 7.5cm (H)
 Material: Food-safe, BPA-free, shatter-resistant plastic
 Ventilation weave design reduces dust and odors
 Double-handled design for comfortable carrying
 Smooth edges ensure safe handling
 Stackable design for space-saving storage
How to Use:
 Place items such as toys, toiletries, office supplies, or beauty products inside
 Carry using the built-in double handles
 Nest or stack baskets when not in use
Safety Information:
 Do not overload beyond capacity
 Keep away from fire and high heat
 Clean with mild soap and water only
Package Includes:
 1 × Multi-Purpose Plastic Storage Basket with Handles
